title: The nine unresolved C++ translation units
summary: The final nine were rejected by cfront in the dev16 recorded sweep: NativeActivation(14), CommandIOConfiguration(13), Setup(8), LibraryPackage(9), InternalPackage(14), Interpreter(9), RexxUtilCommon(14), FileNative(14), StreamNative(14). Their complete first-diagnostic logs were not supplied with the dev20 archive.
invariants: Cfront exit status is a symptom, not a root-cause diagnosis.
Never infer a successful cc370 pass where cfront output was unavailable.
The residual-only sweep checks nine units; it does not replace a full 199-unit qualification.
Editing upstream ooRexx sources directly is not a translation compatibility strategy; retain pinned originals and controlled shadow rewrites.
